2969.commentary: (NIDD1) addakkhin'ti addasaṃ adakkhiṃ apassiṃ paṭivijjhin'ti, ath'ettha sallam'addakkhiṃ.

examples.text: osāne'tv'eva byāruddhe, disvā me aratī ahu, ath'ettha sallam'addakkhiṃ, duddasaṃ hadayanissitaṃ.
yadā ca buddham'addakkhiṃ, vicikicchāvitāraṇaṃ, so'mhi vītabhayo ajja, sambuddhaṃ payirupāsiya.

2970.grammar: imperf 3rd pl of addasā, irreg form of addakkhuṃ, trans (+acc)
2970.commentary: (JAa) ye keci m'addakkhū'ti ye keci sattā tasmiṃ himavantapadese tadā kosiyena hiriyā dīyamānaṃ sudhābhojanaṃ addasaṃsu.

examples.text: aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato, anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti
evaṃ visujjhanti apāpakammino, atho suciṇṇassa phalaṃ na nassati, ye keci m'addakkhu sudhāya bhojanaṃ, sabb'eva te indasahabyataṃ gatā.
svādhippāgā bhāradvājo, sañcayassa upantikaṃ, tam'addasa mahābrahmā, nisinnaṃ sam'hi vesmani.
siṅgālo'pi kho, bhikkhave, addasa kummaṃ kacchapaṃ dūrato'va gocarapasutaṃ. disvāna yena kummo kacchapo ten'upasaṅkami.
ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ābādhikaṃ dukkhitaṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ, sake muttakarīse palipannaṃ semānaṃ, aññehi vuṭṭhāpiyamānaṃ, aññehi saṃvesiyamānan'ti?
ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtan'ti? so evam'āha n'āddasaṃ bhante'ti
kiṃ pana, bhante, addasā'ti? na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, addasan'ti.
divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, nāgaṃ ogāham'uttiṇṇaṃ, nadītīramhi addasaṃ.
taṃ kissa hetu? mā maṃ te addasaṃsu ahañ'ca mā te addasan'ti.
addasaṃsu kho, bhikkhave, nevāpiko ca nevāpikaparisā ca tatiyānaṃ migajātānaṃ āsayaṃ, yattha te gāhaṃ agamaṃsu. evañ'hi te, bhikkhave, tatiyā'pi migajātā na parimucciṃsu nevāpikassa iddh'ānubhāvā.
addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ cūḷapanthakaṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo siṅgālaṃ dūrato'va gocarapasutaṃ. disvāna soṇḍipañcamāni aṅgāni sake kapāle samodahitvā app'ossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati.
addasāma kho mayaṃ, bho, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ gacchantaṃ, addasāma ṭhitaṃ, addasāma antaragharaṃ pavisantaṃ, addasāma antaraghare nisinnaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ, addasāma antaraghare bhuñjantaṃ
duddiṭṭhaṃ vata, bho bhāradvāja, addasāma, duddiṭṭhaṃ vata, bho bhāradvāja, addasāma! ye mayaṃ tassa bhoto gotamassa bhūnahuno seyyaṃ addasāmā'ti.
svāgataṃ vata me āsi, gayāyaṃ gayaphagguyā, yaṃ addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ, desentaṃ dhammam'uttamaṃ.
anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti.

2980.commentary: (MNa) add'āvalepanā upakāriyo'ti c'ettha manussā pākārapādaṃ assakhurasaṇṭhānena iṭṭhakāhi cinitvā upari sudhāya limpanti. evaṃ katā pākārapādā upakāriyo'ti vuccanti. tā tintena kalalena sittā add'āvalepanā nāma honti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, add'āvalepanā upakāriyo pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.
kadā nu'haṃ pabbatakandarāsu, ekākiyo addutiyo vihassaṃ, aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

so n'ātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, n'āccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati, so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca adduvena adduvaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati.

so antaraghare nisinno samāno na hatthakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na pādakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na adduvena adduvaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca pāṇinā hanukaṃ upadahitvā nisīdati.
evam'etaṃ, gahapati, evam'etaṃ, gahapati! āturo h'āyaṃ, gahapati, kāyo addhabhūto pariyonaddho.
ye'pi hi keci, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato dakkhissanti… te taṇhaṃ pajahissanti
evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītam'addhānan'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, anussaramāno rūpaṃ'y'eva anussarati
na hi bhavaṃ gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuḍḍhe mahallake addhagate vayoanuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.
yatha'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
sīhapubb'addhakāyo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
māso seso gimhānan'ti, bhikkhunā vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ, addhamāso seso gimhānan'ti katvā nivāsetabbaṃ.

2991.meaning2: who has traversed the span of life
2991.meaningLit: travelled the time; gone the distance

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo mithilāyaṃ paṭivasati jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, vīsavassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū
aham'asmi, bhante, jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇ'ātaṅko.
duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.

2993.meaning2: having the worth of a 1 kahāpaṇa

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bālo passati rājāno coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārente, kasāhi'pi tāḷente vettehi'pi tāḷente addhadaṇḍakehi'pi tāḷente hattham'pi chindante pādam'pi chindante hatthapādam'pi chindante kaṇṇam'pi chindante nāsam'pi chindante kaṇṇanāsam'pi chindante…
yo vāruṇī addhano akiñcano, pipāso pivaṃ papāgato, udakam'iva iṇaṃ vigāhati, akulaṃ kāhiti khippam'attano.

2996.meaning1: long-lasting; enduring for a long time
2996.meaning2: lasting a long period; lasting; enduring; lit. fit for travelling

2999.construction: adhi > adhy > addh + ā + bhava + i
2999.commentary: (SNa) nāmaṃ sabbaṃ addhabhavī'ti nāmaṃ sabbaṃ abhibhavati anupatati.

examples.text: nāmaṃ sabbaṃ addhabhavi, nāmā bhiyyo na vijjati, nāmassa ekadhammassa, sabb'eva vasam'anvagū'ti.
